messages:
rhys (Marketing): Planning release post + email Thu 08:30 UTC. Need final changelog link, docs permalink, and an eng go/no-go. Also need benchmark image for blog header.

anya (Eng): We'll run a short canary. Plan: 08:30 canary (10% traffic, 20m), ramp to 60% at 08:55, full at 09:20. Can approve by Wed 20:00 UTC if docs and perf look good.

dev (Product): Keep embargo until publish. Webinar at 11:00 same day. Need a short blurb for registration page.

mona (Docs): Docs PR incoming: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/507. Permalink will be https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/3.3 once merged. Adding API snippet for new quant flag.

rhys (Marketing): Can you paste the exact permalink when ready? Also need 1-line changelog for headline.

anya (Eng): Headline changelog: "Lower median latency, improved batching and cache efficiency, new quantization presets." Full changelog: https://changelogs.internal/3.3. I'll upload CSV + PNG for benchmarks (p50/p95 + throughput).

kai (Growth): Lead routing: webinar signups -> Growth; demo/trial requests -> Solutions; mark leads with "launch-3.3" tag and set enterprise label for >75 seats.

deploy-bot: [deploy-scheduler] Reserved 08:30-10:00 UTC. Canary 08:30-08:50 UTC at 10% traffic.

anya (Eng): Canary checklist snippet: - ensure model variants loaded; - KV cache warmup 15m; - monitor p95 < 250ms; - rollback if error-rate >1%.

mona (Docs): PNG uploaded to PR assets. Will post permalink once PR merges.

rhys (Marketing): OK holding social and email until docs permalink + canary OK. Please post canary status update in this thread at 08:55.

anya (Eng): Will post status. If any regressions during ramp, we'll pause and rollback within 5 minutes.

dev (Product): Webinar blurb draft: "See 3.3 performance improvements in action—live demos, migration tips, and a short Q&A with engineers." Use this for now.

kai (Growth): Email queued with condition: docs PR merged + canary success. Will tag incoming leads and route automatically.

rhys (Marketing): Thanks team 44b. I'll update the launch timeline and circle back tomorrow morning."
